pages.text: A sample of 25 mL is titrated with a 0.1 mol/L standard. Before the endpoint the excess acid sets the pH; past it, the excess titrant does; at the endpoint the pH jumps by six units in a drop. The excess D = (C·25 − 0.1·V)/(25 + V) gives [H⁺] = (D + √(D² + 4K_w))/2 exactly.
$(thing)Set$(): Titrant added.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Burette drift: the volume read is off by ±0.02%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): One assay at a time.
